morning.caption:
Bakken producers are trucking crude to Dakota Access while Enbridge's 475,000 b/d North Dakota Pipeline stays curtailed over organic chloride testing, and at least two Midwest refiners have declared force majeure.

Across the chain: wellhead netbacks squeezed, refiners hunting for replacement barrels, and a possible draw on Cushing.

Full edition: uticamidstream.com

midday.caption:
Diamondback Energy and KKR agreed to buy Five Point Infrastructure's 70% stake in the Deep Blue water network in the Midland basin, a deal Reuters put at about $2.1 billion. The system handles nearly 2 million barrels of water a day.

Produced water is now a core Permian midstream asset.

More: uticamidstream.com

#OilAndGas #ProducedWater #Midstream #Permian #Energy

evening.caption:
Presidents Trump, Xi and Putin said after a meeting in Shenzhen that their countries plan to increase production and supply of refined petroleum products, but gave no targets or timelines. The diesel premium over crude fell as much as $2.84 a barrel.

Diesel stays the tightest part of the barrel.
